tools.description: Describe the project-confined headless stdio surface, effective capabilities, message bounds, supported tools, and live Protégé tools that are unavailable.
tools.name: get_headless_capabilities

tools.description: Validate the fixed project policy supplied when this stdio server started. Returns structured schema, semantic, and project-containment findings and writes nothing.
tools.name: validate_project_policy

tools.description: Run the complete offline project QC gate against one captured, checksum-verified workspace snapshot using the bundled headless reasoner.
tools.name: run_project_qc

tools.description: Verify the policy-declared locked import closure offline against captured local files and checksums. Non-locked policies report verified=false and write nothing.
tools.name: verify_import_lock

tools.description: Generate the deterministic project import lock from captured local imports. Dry-run is the default; a write uses checksum-guarded atomic replacement with backup.

dry_run.description: When true (default), return the candidate without writing.

tools.name: write_import_lock

tools.description: Run the complete offline release gate and build a bounded preview without writing. Any baseline manifest must resolve inside the fixed project root.
tools.name: run_release_gate

tools.description: Build the verified release bundle. Dry-run is the default; a write publishes the whole project-confined directory failure-atomically after the release gate passes.

dry_run.description: When true (default), compute the bundle without writing.

tools.name: prepare_release

tools.description: Explicitly merge the redacted owner-only project audit streams into one deterministic, bounded JSON Lines artifact. Dry-run is the default.

dry_run.description: When true (default), report the target without writing.

tools.name: export_audit_log
